read_task_state.target: read_json(claim.path) when running; directory inspection otherwise

fault_hooks.checkpoint_failure: MONKEYPATCH atomic_json_write when destination is checkpoints/
fault_hooks.partial_write: SUBPROCESS writes non-.json temporary file then atomic replace
fault_hooks.stale_owner_submission: DIRECT using old Claim after recovery and new claim

lease_fencing.implemented_token: claim_id UUID plus owner plus lease expiry
lease_fencing.formal_audit_requirement: prove only current claim_id can heartbeat or submit after recovery

limitations: No final verdict is issued by this binding file.
Builder does not expose the contract method names directly; a thin independent adapter is required.
read_task_state and read_checkpoint require adapter-level filesystem reads under the isolated runtime root.
